[comment by brisingraerowing (none)]
The error is on Create: Simulated (Aeronautics), not JEI itself. Looks like Simulated tries to mixin to some JEI internals and the new versions are different enough the mixin fails to apply.

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report! 

This crash is caused by Create Simulated 1.3.1 applying an outdated mixin to JEI internals. 
I submitted a fix for them here:
* https://github.com/Creators-of-Aeronautics/Simulated-Project/pull/1403

It has been fixed upstream in Create Simulated/Aeronautics 1.3.2.
